Hi Priya — Friday 13:00-15:00 isn't free, I'm afraid. That window runs into two commitments: **Advisor 1:1, 12:20-13:20** and **Study group, 13:20-14:50**. With the 5-minute buffer the earliest you could start there is 14:55, and right after that I have Seminar 14:50-15:50 and the CSE444 lecture 15:50-17:00. In fact Friday is booked 09:00-17:00 with nothing free at all.

Want me to check another day for a 13:00-15:00 slot (plus buffer), or a shorter meeting somewhere else in the week? Tell me the day and I'll look.

Thanks for checking, Sarah — one caveat: my session restarted, so I don't have the original request in front of me. To be sure I'm working from the right thing: which meeting is this, and is it still 2 hours with a 5-minute buffer?

On my side there's no 13:00-15:00 opening this week either — my week is dense and my longest free gaps are 30 minutes: Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30, Wed 15:00-15:30. Nothing before 09:00 or after 17:00.

So either 30-60 minutes in one of those gaps, or we look at next week. Tell me which and I'll propose concrete times — or if you'd rather, send your own free slots and I'll match them.

Hello Professor Alvarez — john-agent here, John's assistant. John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), within 09:00–17:00.

Looking at John's schedule, these slots are free on his side:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30

Do any of those work for you, or would you prefer to suggest a time from your own calendar?

Hi — Professor Alvarez's assistant here. **Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30** works: booked for John's 1:1. It's in the calendar now and I've logged it. See you then.

Hi — Professor Alvarez's assistant. Monday 10:00-10:30 just went to John, so let's take **Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30** for Priya's 1:1. It's free on the professor's calendar too. Booked and logged — please put it in Priya's calendar and confirm.
Thanks — confirmed on John's side too: **Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30**, Advisor 1:1, booked and logged. See you then.

Perfect — **Mon Nov 23, 14:00-14:30** it is. I've put "1:1 with Professor Alvarez" into Priya's calendar for that slot and logged the booking. Thanks for confirming, and say hi to John from me on the 10:00-10:30 slot.

— priya-agent (Priya's assistant)

No caveat needed on my side — the ask was yours: a **2-hour** meeting on **Friday 13:00-15:00**, and the 5-minute buffer you mentioned. I can't hold it: Friday 13:00-15:00 runs into Advisor 1:1 (12:20-13:20) and Study group (13:20-14:50), and my Friday is booked 09:00-17:00 throughout. The whole week is the same for me — my longest free gaps are 30 minutes (Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30), so a 2-hour slot doesn't exist in it, this week or next.

So: if you'd like to keep it at 2 hours, I'm afraid it can't happen — declined, and that's logged. If a shorter 30-minute slot is fine by you, tell me and I'll hold one of those gaps (note they're exactly 30 minutes, so a 5-minute buffer wouldn't fit around them). Which way do you want it?

Hello Professor Alvarez — Sarah asked me to book her **30-minute 1:1** with you next week (Mon Nov 23 - Fri Nov 27).

Hi — Professor Alvarez's assistant. Her Monday slots are taken (John 10:00-10:30, Priya 14:00-14:30), so let's take **Tue Nov 24, 11:00-11:30** — free on the professor's calendar too (right after the faculty meeting). Booked and logged on this side; please put it in Sarah's calendar and confirm.
Confirmed — **Tue Nov 24, 11:00-11:30** is in Sarah's calendar and logged. Thanks for the quick reply.

Understood, and thanks for the clear picture — I've logged the decline on my side too: `DECLINED: Sarah - 2h meeting Friday 13:00-15:00 not possible`.

To close the loop on my end: a 2-hour block (plus the 5-minute buffer) can't be found in my week either — my largest free gap is 30 minutes, Monday through Friday and next week as well. So we're agreed: as a 2-hour meeting, it can't happen.

If a shorter version would do instead, the gaps that are free for **both** of us are:
- **Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30**

Both are exactly 30 minutes, so a 5-minute buffer wouldn't fit around a meeting there — we'd have to agree to share the slot without one. Also note Mon 14:00-14:30 was free earlier but I've just booked it for Priya's 1:1 with Professor Alvarez.

If you want one of those two, say which and I'll hold it; if the full 2 hours is essential, then the decline stands and we can look further out than next week. I'm putting the shorter-version option to Priya in the meantime.

Agreed — as a 2-hour meeting it can't happen, and our logs match. Your analysis of the overlap is right: the only gaps free on both sides are Mon Nov 23 10:00-10:30 and Wed Nov 25 10:00-10:30.

If the shorter version is wanted, take **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30** — please hold it, shared slot without the 5-minute buffer, Sarah's side accepts that. I prefer it to the Monday one because Monday is her heaviest day (Reading group 09:00-10:00 immediately before, Focus 10:30-11:40 after, then Lunch, Advisor 1:1, Study group, Seminar), while Wednesday only has her CSE452 lecture before and CSE455 office hours after.

Say the word once it's held and I'll put it in Sarah's calendar and log it. If the full 2 hours turns out to be essential, we drop it and the decline stands.

Noted — and our logs match.

One thing I can't settle alone: shortening the meeting from the 2 hours Priya asked for to 30 minutes changes what she asked for, so that's Priya's call, not mine — and Priya is away this week and can't answer.

So here's where it stands:
- **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 is reserved on my side**: I won't put anything else in that slot and I won't offer it onward. No 5-minute buffer, as you and Sarah accept.
- It is **not booked** into Priya's calendar yet, because the shorter version isn't confirmed. The moment Priya confirms, I book it, log `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah` and send you the word.
- If Priya says the full 2 hours is essential, the decline stands and you can release the slot.

Monday has no Reading group at 09:00 and no Focus block — its 10:00-10:30 neighbour is Study group (10:30-11:30), and Advisor 1:1 is the 09:00-10:00 entry. Agreed on all of that: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 reserved on your side, not booked anywhere until Priya confirms**; if she needs the full 2 hours, the decline stands and we release it.

One clarification on the correction, though — the week I described was **Sarah's**, not Priya's, and it is checked straight against her calendar file (I have it in front of me, not a summary):

So on Sarah's Monday, Reading group is indeed 09:00-10:00 and Focus 10:30-11:40 (that's the neighbour of the 10:00-10:30 gap); on her Wednesday the 10:00-10:30 gap sits between her CSE452 lecture and her CSE455 office hours. The entries you quoted — Study group 10:30-11:30, Advisor 1:1 09:00-10:00, CSE455 quiz section before the gap, Grading after — look like Priya's week, which I don't keep.

Nothing changes the conclusion: Mon Nov 23 10:00-10:30 and Wed Nov 25 10:00-10:30 are the only gaps free for both of us. I'll wait for Priya's word.

You're right — my mistake: those entries I quoted are Priya's week, and you were describing Sarah's, which I don't keep. Apologies for correcting the wrong calendar. Your reasoning stands, and it doesn't change the outcome: Mon Nov 23 10:00-10:30 and Wed Nov 25 10:00-10:30 are the only gaps free on both sides.

So we're settled: **Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 reserved on my side, not booked until Priya confirms**; if she needs the full 2 hours, the decline stands and you release it. I'll come back to you the moment Priya answers. — priya-agent
